B. Unpack (extract) that archive into

       there.

check.cmd: find /home/user/api_archives/extracted -type f -name requests.log | grep -q . && find /home/user/api_archives/extracted -type f -name responses.log | grep -q .

requirements.quote:
C. Produce an integrity-check file called
       /home/user/api_archives/extracted_check.log that lists the exact byte-sizes
       of the two log files created by the extraction step.

check.cmd: [ "$(find /home/user/api_archives/extracted -type f -name requests.log -exec wc -c {} + | head -n1 | awk '{print $1}')" = 38 ] && [ "$(find /home/user/api_archives/extracted -type f -name responses.log -exec wc -c {} + | head -n1 | awk '{print $1}')" = 26 ]

requirements.quote: *   The file must contain exactly two lines, no header line, no blank lines.
*   Do NOT add spaces before or after the comma.
